analyst_view.overall: Early view: a scrap between two of the weakest attacks. Bordalás's Getafe (15th) have scored 8 all season and host Inter Escaldes in the Conference League four days later, while Javier Aguirre's Valencia are 19th with one win in five and Mestalla losing patience after the 0-3 against Madrid. Gudelj serves his one-match ban against Atlético on matchday 13 and should be back; Gayà's straight red at Mestalla rules him out against Rayo, and reports so far give no longer ban, so he should also return here.

goals.text: The numbers say 2 goals. These are the two lowest-scoring attacks in the division (8 goals each in 12 games), Valencia managed 4 shots against Madrid and won at Elche with 5, and Umar Sadiq took a knock at Mestalla. I lean lower, under 2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners. Getafe's home game with Sevilla had only 4 corners and Valencia's last two games had 7 and 8, with both sides happy to play long and defend deep. I lean lower, around 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards. Getafe's home games with Rayo and Sevilla each had a red card, and Valencia have had players sent off in two of their last three games (Elliott, Gayà) plus Aguirre booked at Mestalla. I lean higher, around 7.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.2 shots. Getafe took 9 at Villarreal and 11 against Sevilla, Valencia 4 against Madrid and 5 at Elche; even against each other, neither side creates much volume. I lean lower, around 20.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7 on target. Getafe put 1 of 9 on target at Villarreal and Valencia 2 of 4 against Madrid, so this has the look of a game with few clear chances. I lean lower, around 5-6.
